queries.query_name: Unpinned Package Version in Pip Install
queries.description: Package version pinning reduces the range of versions that can be installed, reducing the chances of failure due to unanticipated changes

files.search_key: FROM={{group-docker-61.nexuscloud.aws.rabo.cloud/python:3.12-slim AS builder}}.{{RUN pip install     --no-cache-dir     --index-url https://nexus3.rabobank.nl/repository/pypi-proxy/simple     --trusted-host nexus3.rabobank.nl     poetry=2.1}}
files.expected_value: RUN instruction with 'pip/pip3 install <package>' should use package pinning form 'pip/pip3 install <package>=<version>'
files.actual_value: RUN instruction pip install     --no-cache-dir     --index-url https://nexus3.rabobank.nl/repository/pypi-proxy/simple     --trusted-host nexus3.rabobank.nl     poetry=2.1 does not use package pinning form
